Title: Document 1
Content: Source: Charles-François Poerson, portrait of Louis `text(XIV)` (`text(1654)`) sitting on the throne of the supreme Roman god Jupiter. The painting commemorated the king's defeat of the Fronde, a rebellion of nobles (`text(1648)-text(1653)`), and was displayed at the palace complex of Versailles.
:ibox:Translation of the Latin inscription on the plaque below the painting: “Jupiter, applauding Louis, ceases his thundering and now the world sees that a new Jupiter has arrived.”
